name: Pennant String
description: Strings of party bunting drooping across the sheet row under row, hung with bright pennants and swallowtail flags.

code.style: --rule: ( --l: @calc((10 + (36 + 22 * ((@y % 3) / 2)) * 4 * ((@x - 1) / @X) * (1 - ((@x - 1) / @X)))); --r: @calc((10 + (36 + 22 * ((@y % 3) / 2)) * 4 * (@x / @X) * (1 - (@x / @X)))); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc($(l) * 1% - 1.2%); width: $(sqrt(10000 + (r - l) * (r - l)))%; height: 2.4%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transform-origin: 0 50%; transform-origin: 0 50%; -webkit-transform: rotate($(atan2(r - l, 100) * 57.29578)deg); transform: rotate($(atan2(r - l, 100) * 57.29578)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; width: 84%; top: $((l + r) / 2)%; height: 82%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @p(@var(--pennant), @var(--swallow)); clip-path: @p(@var(--pennant), @var(--swallow)); -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 0; transform-origin: 50% 0; -webkit-transform: rotate($(atan2(r - l, 100) * 57.29578)deg); transform: rotate($(atan2(r - l, 100) * 57.29578)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --pennant: polygon(10% 0%, 90% 0%, 70% 40%, 50% 80%, 30% 40%); --swallow: polygon(12% 0%, 88% 0%, 88% 74%, 50% 50%, 12% 74%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
